name: sdi
description: Scenario-Driven Implementation engine for Claude Code. Natural-language GWT scenarios as first-class citizens; LLM implements + verifies + auto-regresses.

skillsList.name: sdi-overview
skillsList.description: SDI orientation — entities, lifecycle, GWT discipline, regression model, evidence rules, MCP tool map, failure-code recovery

skillsList.name: sdi-scenario
skillsList.description: Natural-language → Given/When/Then converter for SDI scenarios; daemon enforces non-empty clauses

skillsList.name: sdi-round
skillsList.description: Create and activate SDI rounds; strict-regression default, in-flight task policy, disruption review, task auto-decomposition

skillsList.name: sdi-evidence
skillsList.description: Record structured TaskEvidence (code / test / ci / external / transcript) at task done

skillsList.name: sdi-init
skillsList.description: Cold-start the spec for a new/empty project — requirement prompt → first product-definition documents (oracle backbone) via oracle-author, then hand off to sdi-converge. Front half of the planning loop; detects the vacuous empty-oracle complete verdict

skillsList.name: sdi-converge
skillsList.description: Outer loop — spec convergence to the completeness oracle (D31/D34/D35): scan oracle/verify, §2a-eliminate decision-points, auto-decide facts / ask preferences, loop until uncovered=0 & unanswered=0 & unasked=0, then approve

skillsList.name: sdi-impl-loop
skillsList.description: Inner loop — implementation convergence over rounds (D30/D31): decompose → impl → test → bounded-N retry / escalate, complete on all-pass, auto-open next round on regression, loop until regressions=0
